text_to_speech: - Today is a momentous day for our state. Today launches a transformational growth for our state's land grant institution. And Boilermakers are excited to serve the people, business and communities in Indianapolis. We will maximize Indy's unique strengths, such as sports and biomedicine. We will connect talents with industry. - Now is indeed the time to think differently, to aspire for more, to untether these great institutions, and allow friendly competition to drive progress and innovation to the benefit of all Hoosiers. - [Chiang] To that, Boiler Up! (audience applauds and cheers) (bright, happy piano music)
youtube_description:
#BoilerUp, Indy! Purdue University in Indianapolis is official. 

President Mung Chiang and Board of Trustees Chair Mike Berghoff, along with their Indiana University counterparts, signed paperwork at a June 14 event officially launching the new, fully integrated extension of our flagship campus – Purdue University in Indianapolis. 

Watch highlights from today’s historic event and hear state and local leaders explain how Purdue University in Indianapolis will fuel growth and accelerate an innovation-based economy benefiting not just Indiana, but the entire world.  

Purdue University in Indianapolis will bring the academic rigor and accessible excellence we’re known for to central Indiana – preparing the graduates our world needs in critical and emerging fields, including cybersecurity, advanced manufacturing, microelectronics, artificial intelligence, data analytics, biomedical engineering, sports technology, motorsports engineering, aerospace transportation and more – starting in 2024.  

Learn more about our newest campus: https://www.purdue.edu/campuses/indianapolis/ 

Watch more videos from Purdue:    youtube.com/purdue    

#Purdue #PurdueUniversity #Boilermakers
